_note: Corpus catalogue for the ADR-0035 §8 rehearsal. Every source is pinned to a dataset revision and named parquet files, so a slice is reproducible byte for byte. The `declaration` block is the corpus-admission declaration ADR-0035 leaves as an open obligation (generatedBy, curatedBy): it is made here, by whoever edits this file, and every lineage record that reads these objects carries it as DECLARED. Model names are identifiers, not links.

fineweb-edu-2024-10.role: L-A (pass pair, E1, E3, E4 fail cases) and one side of E5

curators: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct (annotator of the classifier's training labels)
declaration.notes: Filtered from FineWeb (Common Crawl) by an educational-quality classifier trained on Llama-3-70B-Instruct annotations. Web text after ~2022 contains unlabeled model output: residual, ADR-0035 §7.

fineweb-2024-10.role: L-C (E3 fail case: FineWeb-Edu is a filtered subset of FineWeb)

declaration.notes: Same Common Crawl dump as fineweb-edu-2024-10. Unlabeled model text: residual.

fineweb-edu-2023-50.role: Other side of E5 (same curator classifier, different crawl)

curators: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct (annotator of the classifier's training labels)
declaration.notes: A different crawl, the same classifier. Near-duplicate overlap with 2024-10 is expected (recrawled pages) and is measured, not assumed.

pg19.role: L-B (pass pair) and L-D (E4 fail case): non-web, non-synthetic

declaration.notes: PG-19 (Rae et al., 2019): Project Gutenberg books published before 1919, selected by date, not by a model. Mirror of deepmind/pg19. Not a Common Crawl derivative, though Gutenberg text is on the web and so appears in crawls: measured by E3, not assumed away.

tinystories-a.role: L-T (distillation) and one side of E2

declaration.notes: Eldan & Li (2023). Every story was generated by GPT-3.5 or GPT-4; the split between them is not labeled per story, so both are charged with the whole share (over-approximation).

tinystories-b.role: Other side of E2: disjoint files, common generators

declaration.notes: Disjoint parquet file from tinystories-a. E2 should fail on the common generators alone; E3 near-duplicate overlap between formulaic stories is measured too.
